snapshots.notes: Canonical export of the app's illustrative fixture placements. Nothing in it was measured: the enclosure calibration is UNRESOLVED and every placement is illustrative. It records a configuration, not the physical Deck 001 as built, and no fit, clearance or fabrication conclusion may be drawn from it. Replacing it needs a new, explicitly relabelled snapshot backed by physical evidence.
